svg.title: Sisukas course data architecture
svg.text: FastAPI · Cloud Run · stateless, no database
frontend/course-browser/src/data · hand-edited · bundled at build time
frontend/course-browser · everything below is composed in memory
study groups · browser calls sisu-wrapper directly, not via the backend
not used by the daily workflow
reduce fields, normalise dates, JSON Schema check
keep ongoing · archive ended (≤ 20 % guard) · fail on dup ids
historical.json + hash only uploaded when it changed
1 Kori: search course units → assessment items
2 Kori: list CUR ids in the date window
3 Course API: fetch each CUR payload
same IndexedDB cache + its own hash;
lazy: “all” mode or warm-up after A
best effort: failure keeps the baseline
only if the code is in neither index;
stored rows appear on the next load
1 user opens an instance or plan block
4 merge events sharing a time slot
no network · not merged with courses
active record wins on id overlap
writes nothing back to GCS or PostgreSQL
